A Little Reminder for You

I know today wasn't the easiest. I wish I could have been there to hold you close and make things feel a little lighter. Since I can't do that right now, I made you a few little reminders instead. Take them one at a time, my love. ♡

A reminder for your heart

One difficult day does not define you. You are still doing better than you think, and I am so proud of you.

Please don't forget

Things I hope you remember ♡

You are allowed to have bad days.You don't have to be happy or strong every single moment.
You are learning.You are not expected to know everything already. Every day teaches you something.
Your effort matters.Even when a day doesn't go as planned, that doesn't erase how hard you try.

For the days you need it most

On your difficult days ♡

You are allowed to come home tired. You are allowed to cry, feel disappointed, or need a little time for yourself.

You do not have to turn every difficult experience into a lesson straight away. Sometimes it is enough to rest, breathe, and try again when you are ready.

One day that felt hard does not mean you chose the wrong path. It means you are human, and you are learning. Please give yourself the same patience you would give someone you care about.

A few words from me to you

My little letter

My love,

I know today was difficult, and it makes me wish even more that I could be next to you right now, give you a long hug, kiss your forehead and remind you that everything is going to be okay.

Please don't be too hard on yourself. You are still learning, growing and finding your way. You don't need to get everything right, and you never have to pretend that you're okay when you're not. I'm proud of you for showing up and trying, even on the days that feel difficult.

I hope tomorrow is kinder to you. But if it isn't, please remember that you can always talk to me, be quiet with me, or simply let me keep you company. You never have to earn my love by having a perfect day.

And just in case you haven't heard it enough today: you are wonderful, you are capable, you are loved, and I believe in you. So, so much.

I'm sending you the biggest hug until I can give you one for real. I can't wait for our next call, but please take all the time you need, okay? ♡

With all my love,
Tom ♡
♡

Tomorrow is a new little chapter.

You don't have to make it a perfect one. Just take it step by step, breathe, and remember that someone over here is always cheering for you.

I love you, Maëva. ♡
